key_insight: Syn4D supplies a large-scale synthetic multiview 4D dataset with ground-truth camera motion, dense depth, per-point dense tracking, and parametric human-pose annotations, enabling accurate training and evaluation for dynamic scene reconstruction from video.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of high-quality datasets that provide dense, complete, and accurate geometric annotations for dynamic scenes, which has limited progress in dense 3D reconstruction and tracking from monocular video.
method: Generate diverse dynamic scenes and human motion in a synthetic rendering pipeline to produce photorealistic multiview video sequences.
Render synchronized camera streams with exact ground-truth camera poses, per-frame depth maps, and dense tracking correspondences across time and views.
Provide parametric human-pose annotations (e.g., SMPL-style) alongside dense geometric labels to support reconstruction, tracking, and pose-estimation tasks.
impact: Syn4D gives researchers and practitioners a comprehensive benchmark and training resource to develop and evaluate methods for dynamic 3D reconstruction, tracking, and human-pose estimation, reducing reliance on costly real-world annotation.
